errors.assignmentDoesNotFit: That marcher's move doesn't fit the transition: it must stay inside the transition's range, and use a slot the transition has.
errors.assignmentOutsideTransition: A marcher's move must stay inside its transition. Adjust the transition's range, or the move's.
errors.assignmentOverlap: That marcher already has a move on the same layer at those beats. Put one of them on a different layer, or move it.
errors.blockTooSmall: The block doesn't have enough places for every slot. Add rows or columns, or use fewer slots.
errors.database: The change couldn't be saved, so nothing was changed. Try again, and report it if it keeps happening.
errors.destinationInvalid: A destination isn't valid. Destinations must be finite points on the field.
errors.destinationShapeUnsuitable: That destination doesn't fit the transition. A follow-the-leader transition can't end on a block, and a block needs at least as many places as the transition has slots.
errors.followLeaderBlock: A follow-the-leader transition can't end on a block. Choose a line, curve, circle or box instead.
errors.followLeaderNeedsShape: A follow-the-leader transition needs a shape to follow.
errors.legacyConvertedTimeline: This file was converted to timelines by an earlier development build, which put several page moves in one timeline, so it can't be edited. Convert it again: open its backup (the file saved next to it before the conversion).
errors.notReady: The timeline is still loading. Try again in a moment.
errors.numberOutOfRange: A number is out of range. Beats, layers, slot counts and positions must be whole or finite numbers within the allowed limits.
errors.pathParamsInvalid: That path setting isn't valid. An arc's bulge can be at most half the distance between its ends, and waypoints must be points on the field.
errors.shapeInvalid: That shape isn't valid. Its points must be on the field, a line needs two different end points, a freehand path needs some length, and a circle, box or block needs a positive size.
errors.shapeOrDestinations: A transition uses either a shape or one individual destination for every slot, never both and never fewer.
errors.slotOutOfRange: That slot doesn't exist. A transition's slots are numbered from 0 up to one less than its slot count.
errors.transitionSpansTimeline: A transition must span its whole timeline, starting and ending with it. Change the timeline's range instead, and its transitions move with it.
errors.unknown: The timeline couldn't make that change.
